title: ToolRequest
description: A single compiled tool invocation derived from an approved IntentIR. Only read-only commands are permitted in v1.

intent_id.description: Back-reference to the IntentIR that generated this request

command.description: Executable name. Only 'git' permitted in v1.

args.description: Argument list. No shell expansion permitted.

working_directory.description: Absolute path where the command will run

read_only.description: Must always be true in v1
